CA.name: American skullcap
CA.citation: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder, Scutellaria lateriflora; native range explicitly includes Quebec and Newfoundland

DE.name: Amerikanisches Helmkraut
DE.citation: Species-specific name across independent German retailers (Magic Garden Seeds, eerlijkgezond.com), explicitly disambiguated from Sumpf-Helmkraut (S. galericulata) and Baikal-Helmkraut (S. baicalensis)

ES.name: Escutelaria de Virginia
ES.citation: Consistent species-specific name across independent Spanish sources (Farmaceuticonline, Magic Garden Seeds ES, Wikiwand ES), explicitly disambiguated from Escutelaria del Baikal/china (S. baicalensis) and Escutelaria comun (S. galericulata)

FR.name: Scutellaire americaine
FR.citation: L'Herboristerie Yannick Bohbot; used specifically to disambiguate from Scutellaria galericulata, which independently holds the name "Scutellaire casquee" per Wikiphyto - a genuine French naming collision between the two species

GB.name: American skullcap
GB.citation: Correctly and predominantly used for Scutellaria lateriflora by UK specialist herbal retailers (Earthsong Seeds, The Spiceworks) and herbalreality.com; confidence held at medium rather than high because at least one UK wildflower retailer (Naturescape) was found incorrectly applying the same name to the native S. galericulata

US.name: American skullcap
US.citation: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder; also documented as blue skullcap, mad-dog skullcap, side-flowering skullcap
